Let me check whether there's a sqlpipe codebase here to pull the actual message from.I can't produce this. There's no sqlpipe source in this workspace, and the only match for "sqlpipe" is an unrelated scratchpad file.

Writing the "exact error message text" from memory would mean fabricating a string I can't verify against the actual source. sqlpipe wraps AWS SDK errors, and the precise wording depends on which version and code path you're on, so any 2–4 lines I invented would look authoritative but likely be wrong.

To get the real text, point me at one of:
- The sqlpipe source (repo path or clone) so I can find where it formats S3 upload errors.
- A log/console capture of the actual failure.

With either, I'll return the exact message.
